claims.statement: Theogony-domain owns pure domain records, identifiers, provenance models, and error types with zero external storage or persistence dependencies.

Theogony's Rust workspace is structured into six discrete crates (`theogony-domain`, `theogony-ports`, `theogony-db-sqlite`, `theogony-gedcom`, `theogony-ai`, and `theogony-app`) to enforce separation of concerns between domain logic, persistence, interchange, AI, and the Tauri desktop shell.
The desktop application utilizes Tauri to bridge a React and TypeScript frontend with Rust backend command handlers, event brokers, and generated TypeScript bindings.
Persistence is implemented via an ACID-compliant SQLite backend supporting versioned migrations, WAL mode, foreign key enforcement, and explicit transaction boundaries.

Theogony's Rust workspace is structured into six discrete crates (`theogony-domain`, `theogony-ports`, `theogony-db-sqlite`, `theogony-gedcom`, `theogony-ai`, and `theogony-app`) to enforce strict separation of concerns between pure domain logic, port interfaces, persistence, GEDCOM/THEB interchange, AI analysis, and the Tauri desktop shell.

Theogony implements a local-first desktop application architecture using Tauri for the native desktop shell, React, TypeScript, Fluent UI v9, and TanStack Virtual for the UI, and SQLite for ACID-compliant local storage.
Theogony-domain contains pure domain records, identifiers, provenance models, and error types with zero external database or storage framework dependencies.
The persistence layer (`theogony-db-sqlite`) provides an ACID-compliant SQLite backend supporting WAL mode, foreign key enforcement, versioned schema migrations, and transaction management.
Tauri IPC commands bridge the React frontend to Rust backend services, while TypeScript API bindings are automatically generated from Rust types using ts-rs and verified via CI scripts.
Theogony is structured as a Cargo workspace containing discrete crates for domain models, ports, SQLite persistence, GEDCOM interchange, AI assistance, and the Tauri desktop application.
The `theogony-app` crate serves as the Tauri shell and desktop application entrypoint, acting as the sole crate aware of all other workspace crates.
Application operations are implemented as plain Rust functions over AppState within `theogony-app/src/commands/` with transport adapters on top.
The frontend user interface is built with React and Fluent UI v9 running inside the Tauri desktop shell.
Theogony organizes its Rust backend into a modular workspace containing six dedicated crates: theogony-domain, theogony-ports, theogony-db-sqlite, theogony-ai, theogony-gedcom, and theogony-app.

The user interface is built as a native-feeling desktop application using React, TypeScript, and Fluent UI v9 inside Tauri, communicating with the Rust backend via Tauri IPC commands and generated TypeScript bindings.

The persistence layer utilizes ACID-compliant SQLite with WAL mode, foreign key enforcement, migration management, and transaction boundaries wrapped behind repository traits defined in theogony-ports.
Theogony's Rust workspace is organized into seven core crates: theogony-domain, theogony-ports, theogony-db-sqlite, theogony-gedcom, theogony-ai, theogony-dna, and theogony-app.
